business_summary: Shanghai Aladdin Biochemical Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of scientific research reagents and laboratory consumables primarily under Aladdin and i-quip brands in China and internationally. It offers chemistry and biochemical reagents, including blocks, ligands, catalysts, chemical synthesis, laboratory chemicals, chemical biology, analytical standards, CVD and ALD precursors, and stable isotopes; material science solutions for energy, electronic, and biomedical materials; and small molecules, such as compound libraries, ligand families, antibody-drug conjugates, and protein degradation-targeting chimeras, as well as classification by signaling pathway, target toxin, and disease. The company also provides life sciences comprising protein, antibody, and molecular, protein, and cell biology; GMP-grade products, which include bioactive small molecules, grade protein, upstream process chemicals, downstream process and formulation chemicals, and culture medium and buffer raw materials. In addition, it offers laboratory equipment, such as miscellaneous tools; tweezers, scrapers, and tools; PCR supplies and equipment; balance, scale, and weighing tools; sealing film, foil, and tape; filtration and chromatography; microscope slides; liquid handling and dispensing; sample processing; glassware; and safety, gloves, eyeglasses, and cleaning products. The company sells its reagents products under the Aladdin brand and its experimental consumables under the Core Silicon Valley brand through its e-commerce platform. Its products are used in analytical chemistry, chemical synthesis, materials science and engineering, biopharmaceutical production, drug discovery, and genomics applications. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Shanghai, China.
